name: August 28, 2024 Meeting
agenda_text:
Notice of Cancellation
  Malibu Environmental Review Board

  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, August 28, 2024

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the regularly scheduled meeting of the
Malibu Environmental Review Board for Wednesday, August 28, 2024, at
9:00 a.m., has been cancelled.

The next regular meeting is set for September 25, 2024.

Should there be any questions regarding this notice, please call the Planning
Department at (310) 456-2489, ext. 309.

Dated: August 14, 2024 at 2:30 p.m.

__________________________________
Gail Duncan, Administrative Assistant
